kHxPropertyUserInterfaceDomain  Hx User Interface property Domain This property domain covers user interface properties, such as colors and line sizes. Colors are defined as ARGB integers encoded like (b << 24 | g << 16 | r << 8 | a). This matches the memory layout of the HxColor_t structure so one can use HxPropertyGetInt(..., 0, &color) to obtain the correct value.

Note: When a color property refers to a list, the color will be applied to listboxes, dropdownboxes, and comboboxes alike.

kHxPropertyUIColorApplicationWindowBackground  This color is used by applications like Preferences and the File Manager, where there are containers that cover most of the display. kHxPropertyUIColorApplicationWindowBackground is seen in the app window not covered by the containers.
kHxPropertyUIColorProfileHighlight  This color is used by applications like Preferences and the File Manager, where there are containers with frames that almost fill the display. kHxPropertyUIColorApplicationWindowBackground is drawn in the areas not covered by the containers.
kHxPropertyUIColorIconHighlightBg  When the application bar contains gadgets, the system takes care of drawing a highlighted background color when the cursor moves over the gadget, and drawing the pressed background color wwith a button down on the gadget. kHxPropertyUIColorIconHighlightBg and kHxPropertyUIColorIconPressedBg allows applications to implement the system behavior.

00332 /* Note that HX_PROPERTY_POWER_DEFAULT_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT does NOT effect the 
00333    default inactivity timeout in the general preferences panel on the gadget
00334    in most circumstances.  It does set the inactivity timeout when hxpreferences
00335    is run in the simulator.
00336 
00337    The reason for this discrepancy is that the gadget runs a power demon
00338    (powerd) that sets the inactivity timeout default, using the
00339    'keepalive_when_on' value specified in powerd.conf.  This demon is not 
00340    running when the application is run in the simulator. The HX_PR..TIMEOUT
00341    value will only effect the inactivity timeout value on the gadget if 
00342    for some reason the power demon is not running. 
00343 */ 
00344 #define HX_PROPERTY_POWER_DEFAULT_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT   300  /* 300 seconds = 5  min */
